title: 高速比较器 PWM 故障检测
description: COMP is configured to trigger a PWM fault when positive input exceeds AVCC/2. The 8-bit DAC is used to set the negative threshold of the comparator while the positive input is connected to an external pin. A PWM will be driven when the comparator input is below AVCC/2 and then stop when the input go（SDK 例程：comp_hs_tima_pwm_fault）
